note: Every flag from goalline history on the last 200 PRs merged into main (first-parent) of pallets/click (clone at 2247b35, 2026-10-04) and pallets/jinja (5ef7011, 2025-06-14), with the PR's own reason. Checked 2026-10-24 against each PR's text, its changelog lines and click's docs. label: intended | intended, not in the changelog | test plumbing.

pallets/jinja.env: Python 3.11; 103 PRs with pytest 9.0.2 and MarkupSafe 3.0.4, the 97 from 2020-21 (their code imports markupsafe.soft_unicode and uses py.path pytest hooks) with pytest 6.2.5 and MarkupSafe 1.1.1

notJudgedWhy.1525: tests/test_debug.py: its failing old test fails on its own code on Python 3.11 too (tracebacks print differently)
notJudgedWhy.1169: tests/test_loader.py: 6 failing old tests fail on their own code here too
notJudgedWhy.1233: tests/test_idtracking.py: an old test crashes inside the new code before its expectations

flags.title: use `posixpath.join` when loading template names
flags.moved: package template file names end in `foo/test.html`, not `foo\test.html`
flags.why: template names are joined with `/` on every OS now
flags.label: intended

flags.title: remove deprecated code
flags.moved: overriding the legacy `resolve` no longer warns (`DID NOT WARN`)
flags.why: the deprecated legacy code it warned about was removed
flags.label: intended

flags.title: deprecate legacy resolve mode
flags.moved: overriding `resolve` raises a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: the deprecation itself (jinja's tests turn warnings into errors)
flags.label: intended

flags.title: async support doesn't require patching
flags.moved: the old test files import `jinja2.asyncsupport`, which is gone
flags.why: the module was removed; async support is built in
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Markup and escape should be imported from markupsafe
flags.moved: `jinja2.Markup` and `jinja2.escape` raise a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: the re-exports are deprecated in favour of markupsafe
flags.label: intended

flags.title: unify/rename context function decorators
flags.moved: `contextfunction` and its siblings raise a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: renamed to `pass_context`, `pass_eval_context` and `pass_environment`
flags.label: intended

flags.title: add 'is filter' and 'is test' tests
flags.moved: `no filter named 'f'` became `No filter named 'f'.` and `No filter named 'f' found.`
flags.why: filters and tests share their code now; the new error text is in neither the PR text nor the changelog
flags.label: intended, not in the changelog

flags.title: deprecate 'autoescape' and 'with' extensions for removal in 3.1
flags.moved: the `autoescape` and `with` extensions raise a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: both are built in now
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Drop Python 2
flags.moved: the undefined-variable warning `missing is undefined` became `'missing' is undefined`; old files import the removed `jinja2._compat`
flags.why: Python 2 support removed and f-strings used everywhere; the new warning text is in neither the PR text nor the changelog
flags.label: intended, not in the changelog

flags.title: Revert "Rename to Jinja"
flags.moved: the old test files import `jinja`
flags.why: the package rename was reverted to `jinja2`
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Add `Parameter.spec` and deprecate `human_readable_name`
flags.moved: `option 'my_option' is deprecated` became `The option '--my-option' is deprecated.`
flags.why: messages name options as users type them; the changelog quotes the before and after
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Deprecate parameter names that are: not a Python identifier, or a Python Keyword, or not lower-cased
flags.moved: an option named `in` raises a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: the deprecation itself
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Merge stable into main
flags.moved: the short help of `123 567 9. aaaa bbb` is `123 567...`, not `123 567 9.`
flags.why: a period followed by a lowercase word no longer ends a sentence ("Fix short help abbreviation", in the changelog)
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Refactor pager stream handling
flags.moved: output through the null pager to a non-terminal stream loses its colour codes; an internal helper returns a different shape
flags.why: pager streams unified; the PR's tests expect the colour change, but neither its text nor its changelog line mentions it
flags.label: intended, not in the changelog

flags.title: Deprecate `isolated_filesystem` and document its limits
flags.moved: `CliRunner.isolated_filesystem` raises a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: the deprecation itself
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Mark clearly functions private status. Deprecated Python 2 utilities.
flags.moved: `get_binary_stream`, `KeepOpenFile`, `LazyFile` and `make_default_short_help` raise a `DeprecationWarning`
flags.why: Python 2 era utilities deprecated
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Fix parsing when a parameter is named `help`
flags.moved: `to_info_dict()` shows the help option under `_click_default_help`
flags.why: the help option's internal name changed so a parameter named `help` works; in the changelog
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Merge `stable` into `main` after `CHANGES` rST to Markdown conversion
flags.moved: the old test file imports `click._compat.MAC`, which is gone
flags.why: a private constant used only to skip a test was removed while fixing a test race
flags.label: test plumbing

flags.title: Merge stable into main
flags.moved: case-insensitive `Choice` completion suggests `au`, not `Au`
flags.why: completion goes through `normalize_choice()` now; the changelog mentions Enum completion, not the lowercased suggestions
flags.label: intended, not in the changelog

flags.title: Add capture mode to `CliRunner` and revert default `fileno` exposure
flags.moved: `CliRunner` streams no longer have a `fileno()`
flags.why: the revert in the title; a new capture mode brings it back
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Add `NoSuchCommand` exception with suggestions for misspelled commands
flags.moved: `No such option: --foo` became `No such option '--foo'.`, and `Did you mean --count?` became `Did you mean '--count'?`
flags.why: error messages reformatted for consistency, as the PR says
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Fix: Ensure fish completion handles multiline help strings correctly
flags.moved: fish completion output escapes the newlines in help
flags.why: the fix itself
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Auto-detect `type=UNPROCESSED` when `flag_value` has non-basic types
flags.moved: enum, class and int flag values arrive as objects, not strings
flags.why: the point of the PR
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Reconcile default value passing and default activation
flags.moved: `default=True` with `flag_value=False` activates the flag: `Flag [y/N]` became `Flag [Y/n]`, and Enter gives `True`
flags.why: what `default=True` means for flags was redefined
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Fix callable ``flag_value`` being instantiated when used as a default
flags.moved: a class used as `flag_value` arrives as the class, not an instance
flags.why: the fix itself
flags.label: intended

flags.title: fix a race in `click.testing.StreamMixer`'s finalization, seen in a multi-threaded context
flags.moved: the captured streams close when isolation ends, so reading them afterwards fails
flags.why: the race fix (in the changelog); the PR moved the tests' checks inside the block
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Fix reconciliation of envvar with `default`, `flag_value` and `type` parameters for flag options
flags.moved: flag values from env vars and defaults (`upper` where it was `False`)
flags.why: the fixes the title lists
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Raise an exception on end of input in CliRunner
flags.moved: prompts in `CliRunner` abort at the end of input (`Aborted!`) instead of reading empty strings
flags.why: match a real terminal, where the end of input raises
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Expand `Choice` token normalization + make generic
flags.moved: custom `ParamType.get_metavar()` is called with `ctx`; `Choice` info dicts changed
flags.why: `Choice` made generic; the new `ctx` argument is in click's 'support multiple versions' guide
flags.label: intended

flags.title: Add help parameter to arguments
flags.moved: `to_info_dict()` gains `help` for arguments (lines only added)
flags.why: the feature itself
flags.label: intended

flags.title: `ParamType` and other typing improvements
flags.moved: importing click also imports `abc` now (lines only added to the allowed list)
flags.why: `ParamType` became an abstract base class
flags.label: intended
